description: The Agri-food data portal is the European Commission's source of market data on European agriculture, run by the Directorate-General for Agriculture and Rural Development with data reported by member states. Its agricultural markets section covers imports, exports, prices, production and aid schemes for each sector: beef, pigmeat, eggs and poultry, milk and dairy, fruit and vegetables, cereals, rice, oilseeds and protein crops, olive oil, wine, sugar and fertilisers, with weekly and monthly prices, detailed monthly trade and production series, sector dashboards and weekly PDF market reports. Coverage is the EU and its member states, with current and historical series. Data are free to browse and download, and a machine-to-machine API gives programmatic access; reuse follows the Commission's reuse policy with attribution. Caveats: prices are representative national quotations, not transaction data, series definitions differ between sectors, and trade data lag by some weeks. Simulation uses: price and supply baselines for food supply shock and market disruption models, tracking fertiliser and cereal price spikes, and calibrating agricultural trade flows in cross-border supply chain scenarios. Related records: WFP global food prices (data-wfp-global-food-prices) cover low and middle income countries and the IFPRI Food Security Portal (data-ifpri-food-security-portal) tracks global price volatility and export restrictions.
